This One Pan Chicken & Gravy is an easy and delicious 30 minute dinner!  INGREDIENTS  1 lb chicken breasts  Salt, pepper, garlic powder  3 tbsp butter 3 tbsp flour  2 cups chicken broth  1/2 tsp each of salt, pepper, oregano, and thyme  1 tsp each of paprika, onion powder, garlic powder  INSTRUCTIONS  Cut chicken breasts in half lengthwise to make them thinner. Season the chicken with some salt, pepper, and garlic powder (I don’t use exact measurements for this part).  In a skillet over medium high heat melt 3 tbsp of butter. Once the butter has melted add 3 tbsp of flour and stir continuously until well combined. Let cook for a few minutes while still stirring.  Add 2 cups of chicken broth and stir well. Season with salt, pepper, oregano, thyme, paprika, onion powder, and garlic powder. Stir well and when it starts bubbling add the chicken to the skillet.  Make sure the chicken is covered in the gravy, cover with a lid, and turn the heat down to medium low. Let this cook for 12-15 minutes or until the chicken reaches an internal temp of 165 degrees. My chicken was ready in 12 minutes, but they were pretty thin.  Shred the chicken and serve over mashed potatoes! Enjoy! Let me know if you try it out.  #chickenandgravy #easyrecipe #dinner #onepanmeal #chickenrecipes

Creamy Tuscan Chicken 🍗✨ This creamy Tuscan chicken is packed with juicy seasoned chicken, garlic, spinach, and sweet grape tomatoes in a rich Parmesan cream sauce. It’s perfect served over pasta, mashed potatoes, or rice! 😋  🍗 Creamy Tuscan Chicken Ingredients:  Chicken seasoning  * 2 to 3 chicken breasts, sliced in half * Salt & pepper * ½ tsp smoked paprika * 1 tsp garlic powder * 1 tbsp Italian seasoning * 1 tsp dried parsley * ½ tsp chili flakes (optional) Sauce: * 1 tbsp butter * ½ onion, diced * 3 garlic cloves, minced * 1 cup grape tomatoes, halved * 2 cups spinach * 1 cup heavy cream * ¼ cup grated Parmesan * Salt & pepper, to taste * Fresh parsley Directions: Season the chicken with all the spices. Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a skillet and cook the chicken for 4–5 minutes per side until golden and cooked through. Remove and set aside. In the same skillet, melt the butter and sauté the onion and garlic until fragrant. Add the tomatoes and cook for 2–3 minutes, then stir in the spinach until wilted. Pour in the heavy cream and Parmesan, stirring until smooth and creamy. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Return the chicken to the skillet and let simmer for 2–3 minutes. Garnish with fresh parsley and serve over pasta, mashed potatoes, or rice. Enjoy! 🤍

Here is my One Pot Creamy Chicken Pasta Dinner 🤤🍝 full recipe on my website.  Crispy on the outside, juicy and full of flavor chicken over a rich, creamy, cheesy pasta. Easy comfort food made in one pot! No mess no stress dinner 😊 One Pot Creamy Chicken Pasta:  Ingredients Chicken 2 chicken breasts 1 tbsp olive oil 1–2 tbsp butter 1 tsp Cajun seasoning 1 tsp smoked paprika 1 tsp sweet paprika 1 tsp Italian seasoning 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tsp onion powder Salt and black pepper, to taste Pasta & Sauce 8 oz dry rigatoni 24 oz heavy cream 24 oz chicken broth (add more if needed) 1 tsp Cajun seasoning 1 tsp smoked paprika 1 tsp sweet paprika 1 tsp Italian seasoning 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tsp onion powder 1–2 cups shredded cheese of your choice (I used mozzarella, sharp cheddar, and medium cheddar) Optional Garnish Fresh parsley, chopped Grated Parmesan cheese Red pepper flakes Instructions Season the chicken: Coat the chicken breasts with olive oil, Cajun seasoning, smoked paprika, sweet paprika, Italian seasoning, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and black pepper. Let the chicken marinate in the refrigerator for 15–30 minutes for the best flavor. Cook the chicken: Heat a large pot or skillet over medium-high heat and cook the chicken for about 2–3 minutes per side, or until golden brown and fully cooked. Remove the chicken from the pan and let it rest. Cook the pasta: In the same pot, add the rigatoni, heavy cream, chicken broth, 1–2 tbsp butter, and seasonings. Stir everything together, cover, and let the pasta simmer until al dente, stirring occasionally. Add more broth or cream if needed while the pasta cooks. Add the cheese: Once the pasta is cooked, add your shredded cheese and stir until melted and creamy. I used mozzarella, sharp cheddar, and medium cheddar, but feel free to use whatever cheese you have in the fridge. Finish and serve: Slice the rested chicken and place it on top of the creamy pasta. Garnish with fresh parsley, Parmesan cheese, or red pepper flakes if desired. #easyrecipe  #pasta #chicken #familydinner #onepot

Ingredients:  • 3 lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs, cut into bite-size pieces  • ½ tbsp garlic salt  • 1 tbsp black pepper  • ¼ cup cornstarch (plus a little extra if you want more crunch)  • 2–3 tbsp vegetable oil (for frying) Sauce:  • ½ cup honey  • ¼ cup soy sauce  • 1 tbsp ginger paste  • 2–3 tbsp minced garlic To Finish:  • Sesame seeds  • Green onions, sliced ⸻ Instructions:  1. INGREDIENTS  1 pound chicken breast  salt, pepper, garlic  2/3 cup of oil 2 TBSP of butter 1 cup of flour 2 tsp each of salt, pepper, paprika, garlic powder, and steak seasoning (for flour mixture)  1 cup of milk 1 egg GRAVY 1/3 cup of grease from frying chicken 1/3 cup of flour  3 cups of milk  salt and pepper to taste  INSTRUCTIONS Cut chicken breasts in half lengthwise to make them thinner. Season chicken on both sides with some salt, pepper, and garlic powder.  In a pan heat oil and butter over medium heat.  While the pan is heating up mix together 1 cup of flour, 2 tsp each of salt, pepper, paprika, garlic powder, and steak seasoning.  In a separate bowl or container mix together 1 cup of milk and 1 egg. Dredge chicken in flour mixture, egg mixture, and back in the flour mixture.  Once the oil is hot fry the chicken for a few minutes on each side until golden brown          Remove the chicken from the pan and pour out all but about 1/3 cup of the grease. To make the gravy add 1/3 cup of flour to the grease making a roux. Once grease and flour are well incorporated add 3 cups of milk and keep stirring constantly. Add salt and pepper to taste. Once thickened pour over fried chicken.  #dinner #recipe #mealideas #gravy #chickenfriedchicken

Crispy chicken over mac and cheese  Oil for frying  1lb chicken breast 1 cup breadcrumbs + 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese 2 eggs 1/2 cup flour + seasonings  1 tsp garlic powder 1 tsp onion powder 1 tsp paprika  1/2 tsp black pepper Mac & cheese  Pasta 2 tbsp butter 2 tbsp flour 2 tsp Dijon  1 1/4 cup whole milk 1/4 cup heavy cream 8oz mozzarella  8oz cheddar cheese 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tsp onion powder 1 tsp black pepper 1 tsp paprika  Salt & pepper  Preheat the oven to 350°F. Prepare a breading station using three shallow dishes: one with flour and seasonings, one with beaten eggs, and one with breadcrumbs mixed with Parmesan cheese. Coat each piece of chicken in the seasoned flour, dip into the eggs, then thoroughly coat with the breadcrumb mixture. Heat oil to 350°F in a skillet and fry the chicken until golden brown and crispy, flipping once to ensure even cooking. Transfer the chicken to a wire rack and finish cooking in the oven until the internal temperature reaches 165°F. Meanwhile, cook the pasta according to the package instructions and drain. In a large skillet over medium-low heat, melt the butter. Sprinkle in the flour and stir continuously until it begins to turn a light golden brown. Add half of the seasonings and mix well. Gradually pour in the milk and heavy cream, adding about ¼ cup at a time while stirring continuously. The mixture may look clumpy at first, but continue stirring and slowly incorporating the liquid until the sauce becomes smooth and creamy. Stir in the Dijon mustard and remaining seasonings. Reduce the heat to low and gradually add the cheese, a little at a time, stirring until completely melted and incorporated. Add the cooked pasta and stir until evenly coated in the creamy cheese sauce. Serve warm topped with the crispy chicken. Enjoy 🤎 #macandcheese #chickenrecipe #friedchicken #foodtok

videos.caption: Sticky Chicken Tender, seasoned chicken coated in a sweet and savory sticky sauce, served over warm rice and finished with green onions and sesame seeds. Ingredients For the Chicken 1.5 lbs chicken breast, cut into bite-sized pieces 1 teaspoon each onion powder, garlic powder, and teaspoon salt ½ teaspoon each black pepper and paprika  2 tablespoons olive oil About ⅓ cup cornstarch Olive oil, for cooking For the Sticky Sauce ½ cup soy sauce ⅓ cup brown sugar or honey 1 tablespoon hoisin sauce 1 tablespoon ketchup 1 teaspoon ginger paste ½ tablespoon minced garlic 1 tablespoon cornstarch 2 tablespoons butter For Serving Cooked white rice Sliced green onions Sesame seeds Instructions 1. Add the chicken to a large bowl and season with onion powder, garlic powder, salt, black pepper, and paprika. Add 2 tablespoons of olive oil and toss until the chicken is evenly coated. 2. Sprinkle about ⅓ cup cornstarch over the seasoned chicken and toss until each piece is lightly and evenly coated. This helps give the chicken that tender, velvety texture and creates a great coating for the sauce. 3. In a bowl, whisk together the soy sauce, brown sugar or honey, hoisin sauce, ketchup, ginger paste, minced garlic, and 1½ tablespoons cornstarch until smooth. Set aside. 4. Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken in 2 batches so you don't overcrowd the pan. Cook until golden brown on the outside and cooked through. Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside. 5. Reduce the heat and add 2 tablespoons of butter to the same skillet, scraping up all those flavorful browned bits from the bottom of the pan. 6. Pour the prepared sauce into the skillet. Cook over low heat, whisking frequently, until the sauce begins to bubble and thickens into a glossy, sticky consistency. 7. Add the cooked chicken back to the skillet and toss until every piece is completely coated in the sticky sauce. 8. Spoon the sticky chicken over warm rice and finish with sliced green onion.  #easyrecipe #dinnerideas #quickrecipes #easydinner #dinnerrecipes

Dinners That Pay My Rent, Episode 1: Creamy Garlic Butter Chicken Pasta 🍗🍝 Crispy skin-on chicken over penne in a creamy garlic parmesan sauce, all in one pan. Ready in about 30 minutes. Ingredients: - 2 bone-in, skin-on chicken thighs - Salt & black pepper, to taste - 1 tsp garlic powder - 1 tsp paprika - 4-5 oz penne pasta (about 2 cups dry) For the sauce: - 1 tbsp unsalted butter - 2 garlic cloves, minced - 1/4 cup chicken broth - 2/3 cup heavy cream - 1/4 cup parmesan, freshly grated, plus more for topping - Squeeze of lemon juice (about 1/4 lemon) - Fresh parsley, chopped - 1/2 cup reserved pasta water Steps: 1. Pat the thighs completely dry and season both sides with the salt, pepper, garlic powder, and paprika. 2. Put a pot of well-salted water on to boil for the pasta. 3. Heat a skillet over medium heat and place the chicken skin-side down. Cook 6-8 minutes without moving it, until the skin is golden and crispy. 4. Flip and cook another 5-7 minutes until cooked through (165°F / 74°C inside). Remove and set aside to rest. 5. Cook the penne 1 minute less than the package says. Save 1/2 cup of the pasta water before draining. 6. Lower the skillet heat. Add the butter to the same pan, then the garlic — cook just until fragrant, about 30 seconds. Don't let it brown. 7. Pour in the chicken broth and scrape up all the browned bits from the bottom. 8. Add the heavy cream and parmesan. Simmer 3-5 minutes until it thickens. 9. Toss the drained pasta into the sauce and cook together 1-2 minutes, adding splashes of the pasta water until the sauce is glossy and coats every piece. 10. Squeeze the lemon juice over the pasta, then place the chicken on top. 11. Finish with parsley and extra parmesan, and enjoy! #garlic #butter #chicken #pasta #easyrecipe

Chicken Aflredo Burritos✨🍗🌯#cookingtips #recipeideas #easyrecipes #DinnerIdeas  #foodasmr  Recipe:  For the chicken: * 2–3 chicken breasts, cut into bite-sized cubes * Olive oil * Onion powder * Garlic powder * Paprika * Italian seasoning * Salt and pepper For the creamy garlic Parmesan sauce: * 2 tbsp butter * ½ white or yellow onion, diced * 5 cloves garlic, minced * 1 tbsp flour * 1½–2 cups heavy cream * ½ cup grated Parmesan * 1 handful shredded cheese of choice * Italian seasoning * Salt and pepper For assembling: * medium flour tortillas * Shredded mozzarella * ¼ cup fresh parsley, chopped * Extra Parmesan for garnish Instructions 1. Cut 2–3 chicken breasts into bite-sized cubes. Drizzle with olive oil and season with onion powder, garlic powder, paprika, Italian seasoning, salt, and pepper. Mix until well coated. 2. Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the chicken and cook until golden brown and the internal temperature reaches 165°F. Remove from the pan and set aside in a bowl. 3. In the same pan, melt 2 tbsp butter. Add the diced onion and sauté until translucent. 4. Add the minced garlic and cook for about 30 seconds. Sprinkle in 1 tbsp flour and stir until everything is combined and the flour is cooked in. 5. Slowly pour in 1½–2 cups heavy cream. Add the Parmesan, shredded cheese, Italian seasoning, salt, and pepper. Stir everything together and let simmer until the sauce thickens slightly. 6. Pour about ¾ of the creamy sauce over the cooked chicken. Add ¼ cup chopped fresh parsley and mix until everything is evenly coated. 7. Add the chicken mixture to your tortillas, top with shredded mozzarella, and roll them up tightly. 8. Heat a little oil or butter in a skillet and fry the wraps on both sides until golden brown and crispy and the mozzarella is melted. 9. Garnish with fresh parsley and Parmesan. Serve with a side salad or broccoli and use the remaining creamy garlic Parmesan sauce for dipping!

DUMP & BAKE SMOTHERED CHICKEN DINNER 🍗🤎 The kind of dinner that tastes like you spent all day in the kitchen, but really you just threw everything in a baking dish and let the oven do the work! Tender, juicy chicken smothered in homemade gravy with hardly any effort. Serve it over mashed potatoes or rice with your favorite sides and you’ve got yourself a good home-cooked meal! RECIPE BELOW ⬇️ Ingredients: 2 lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs Olive oil Salt & pepper Garlic powder Onion powder Paprika Cajun seasoning (optional, for a little kick) 1 sprig fresh rosemary 2 tbsp butter 2 cups chicken broth Carrots or your favorite veggies 2 tbsp cornstarch + 2 tbsp water (use 3 tbsp of each for a thicker gravy) Directions: 1. Preheat oven to 350°F. Add chicken thighs and carrots to a baking dish. Drizzle with olive oil and season generously with salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, and Cajun seasoning if using. Don’t be shy with the seasonings! This is where all your flavor comes from, so eyeball it and season heavily. 2. Add rosemary, butter, and chicken broth. Cover tightly with foil and bake at 350°F for approximately 50 minutes. 3. Remove from oven and carefully pour just the broth into a separate bowl or measuring cup. 4. Mix 2 tbsp cornstarch with 2 tbsp cold water to make a slurry. If you prefer a thicker gravy, use 3 tbsp cornstarch and 3 tbsp water instead. Stir the slurry into the hot broth until well combined, then pour everything back over the chicken and veggies. 5. Return to the oven uncovered at 400°F for approximately 20 minutes, or until the gravy has thickened and the chicken is tender and fully cooked (165°F internally). Serve over creamy mashed potatoes or rice with green beans, a warm dinner roll, or whatever your heart desires! That’s the beauty of cooking. Make it how YOU like it! 🤎 Save this one for an easy, comforting weeknight dinner! #easymeal #easyrecipe #momlife #fallvibes #smotheredchicken

COWBOY BUTTER CHICKEN ALFREDO 🤠🧈🍝  If you know me, you know I LOVE anything cowboy butter! This was a 10/10!! Creamy, cheesy, packed with SO much flavor, and ready in under 30 minutes!  INGREDIENTS: * 2–3 chicken breasts, cubed * 12 oz pasta * 1 tbsp olive oil @getgraza  *4 tbsp butter * 1½ cups heavy whipping cream (+ a splash more if needed) * 1 cup mozzarella cheese * ½ cup parmesan cheese * ½ cup pepper jack cheese * 1 tbsp Dijon mustard SEASONINGS (ALL TO TASTE): * Kinder’s Cowboy Butter Seasoning @Kinder's Flavors *Garlic powder * Onion powder * Italian seasoning * Paprika * Slap Ya Mama @Slap Ya Mama  * Salt & pepper INSTRUCTIONS: 1. we love a crockpot meal around here 🙋🏼‍♀️ can’t go wrong with Marry Me Chicken Orzo (full recipe below!)🫶🏼 Ingredients -1.5 lbs boneless, skinless chicken breasts -¾ cup sun-dried tomatoes, mostly drained and chopped -4 cloves garlic, minced -1 small yellow onion, finely diced -2½–3 cups low-sodium chicken bone broth, divided -1 tsp Italian seasoning -½ tsp paprika -1 tsp salt, plus more to taste -1 tsp black pepper -red pepper flakes (to taste, optional) -1½ cups dry orzo -3/4 cup half & half (can use more or less depending on how creamy you like it!) -½ cup freshly grated parmesan cheese -2 cups baby spinach -Fresh basil, for serving Instructions Add chicken breasts, sun-dried tomatoes (I also like to add in a little splash of the oil they’re in too for some extra flavor), garlic, onion, 1½ cups chicken bone broth, Italian seasoning, paprika, salt, pepper, and red pepper flakes to the crockpot. Stir to combine. Cover and cook on low for 3–4 hours or high for 2–3 hours, until the chicken is cooked. Remove the chicken from the crockpot and shred using a hand mixer or two forks. Return the shredded chicken to the crockpot and stir into the sauce. Stir in 1½ cups dry orzo and 1 additional cup chicken bone broth. Make sure the orzo is mostly submerged in liquid! Cover and cook on high for 20–35 minutes, stirring every 10 minutes, until the orzo is tender. Add up to ½ cup additional broth as needed to prevent sticking or drying out. Once the orzo is fully cooked, turn the crockpot to warm. Stir in half & half and freshly grated parmesan until melted and creamy. Then fold in spinach (I’ll recover for another few minutes to let the spinach get soft) Top with fresh basil, extra parmesan, red pepper flakes, etc & enjoy! #cookwithme #crockpotrecipes #easyrecipes #dinnerideas #crockpotdinnerideas

Makes 4 servings. 4 small chicken breasts (or 2 large cut in half) 1 tbsp olive oil 1 tsp Italian seasoning ½ tsp paprika ½ tsp garlic powder Salt and black pepper, to taste 3 cloves garlic, minced ¾ cup low-sodium chicken broth ⅓ cup chopped sun-dried tomatoes, drained 1 cup low-fat cottage cheese ½ cup fat-free milk ½ cup freshly grated Parmesan cheese 2 cups fresh spinach Fresh basil, for garnish 1. Blend the cottage cheese and fat-free milk until completely smooth and creamy. 2. Season the chicken with the Italian seasoning, paprika, garlic powder, salt, and pepper. 3. Creamy Garlic Parmesan Chicken 🍗🧄 Ingredients: • 4 boneless, skinless chicken breasts • 2 tbsp olive oil • 4 garlic cloves, minced • 1 cup heavy cream • 1/2 cup chicken broth • 1/2 cup grated Parmesan cheese • 1 tsp Italian seasoning • 1/2 tsp red pepper flakes • Salt & pepper • 1 cup spinach • Sun-dried tomatoes, optional Instructions: Season the chicken with salt, pepper, and Italian seasoning. Sear in olive oil until golden and cooked through. Remove from the pan. Add garlic, heavy cream, chicken broth, and Parmesan. Simmer until creamy, then add spinach and sun-dried tomatoes. Return the chicken to the pan and coat with the sauce. 🧀✨ 2. Honey Garlic Chicken 🍯🍗 Ingredients: • 1 1/2 lb chicken thighs, boneless • 1/4 cup honey • 1/4 cup soy sauce • 4 garlic cloves, minced • 1 tbsp rice vinegar • 1 tbsp cornstarch • 1 tbsp water • 1 tbsp sesame oil • Green onions Instructions: Cook the chicken in sesame oil until browned and cooked through. Mix honey, soy sauce, garlic, and rice vinegar, then pour over the chicken. Mix cornstarch with water and add it to the pan. Cook until the sauce thickens and coats the chicken. Finish with green onions. 🔥 3. One-Pan Beef & Potatoes 🥩🥔 Ingredients: • 1 lb sirloin steak, cubed • 1.5 lb baby potatoes, halved • 3 tbsp olive oil • 3 garlic cloves, minced • 1 tsp smoked paprika • 1 tsp Italian seasoning • Salt & pepper • 2 tbsp butter • Fresh parsley Instructions: Cook the potatoes in olive oil until golden and tender. Remove and set aside. Sear the beef over high heat until browned. Add garlic, butter, paprika, and Italian seasoning. Return the potatoes and toss everything together. Finish with fresh parsley. 🌿 4. Loaded Cheeseburger Casserole 🍔🧀 Ingredients: • 1 lb ground beef • 1 small onion, diced • 2 cups elbow pasta • 1 cup shredded cheddar cheese • 1 cup milk • 1/2 cup ketchup • 1 tbsp mustard • 1 tsp garlic powder • Salt & pepper • Pickles • Bacon, optional Instructions: Cook the pasta and set aside. Brown the ground beef with onion and garlic powder. Stir in ketchup, mustard, milk, and cooked pasta. Add cheddar and mix until melted. Transfer to a baking dish if needed and top with more cheese, pickles, and bacon. Bake until hot and bubbly. 😋 5. Sheet Pan Lemon Garlic Salmon 🐟🍋 Ingredients: • 4 salmon fillets • 2 tbsp olive oil • 4 garlic cloves, minced • 1 lemon, sliced • 1 tsp dried oregano • Salt & pepper • 1 bunch asparagus Instructions: Place salmon and asparagus on a sheet pan. Drizzle with olive oil and season with garlic, oregano, salt, and pepper. Add lemon slices and bake at 400°F (200°C) for about 12–15 minutes, until the salmon is cooked through. 🌿✨ 6. Chicken Fajita Bowl 🌮🍚 Ingredients: • 1 lb chicken breast, sliced • 1 tbsp olive oil • 1 packet fajita seasoning • 1 bell pepper, sliced • 1 onion, sliced • 2 cups cooked rice • 1 can black beans, drained • Avocado • Sour cream • Salsa • Cheese • Lime Instructions: Cook the chicken in olive oil with fajita seasoning until golden. Add the bell pepper and onion and cook until slightly tender. Build the bowls with rice, black beans, chicken, and vegetables. Top with avocado, sour cream, salsa, cheese, and fresh lime. 🥑🍋‍🟩 7. BBQ Pulled Pork Sliders 🐷🍔 Ingredients: • 2 lb pork shoulder • 1 cup BBQ sauce • 1/2 cup apple cider vinegar • 2 tbsp brown sugar • 1 tbsp smoked paprika • 1 tsp garlic powder • 12 slider buns • Coleslaw Instructions: Place the pork in a slow cooker. Mix BBQ sauce, apple cider vinegar, brown sugar, smoked paprika, and garlic powder, then pour over the pork. Cook on LOW for about 8 hours until very tender. Shred the pork, mix with the sauce, and serve on slider buns with coleslaw. 🔥🤤 #dinnerrecipes #easyrecipes #familydinner #dinnerideas #comfortfood

Garlic Butter Chicken & Potatoes 🍗🥔 I could make this again and again, it was so good… Ingredients 650g chicken breast (or thighs) 1 tbsp oil 1 tsp salt 1 tsp pepper  1 tsp garlic powder 1 tsp onion powder 1 tsp paprika 1 tsp chilli flakes 1 tbsp lemon juice 800g potatoes  1 tbsp oil 1 tsp salt 1 tsp pepper  1 tsp garlic powder 1 tsp onion powder 1 tsp paprika 1 tsp oregano 1 tsp thyme 1 tbsp butter 5-6 cloves garlic Fresh parsley Recipe 1. Dice the chicken and add oil 2. Season with salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika and chilli flakes 3. Add some lemon juice and mix well then leave to marinate 4. Peel the potatoes and dice them into medium-sized cubes 5. Add oil then season the potatoes with salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, oregano and thyme 6. Place in the air fryer at 200°C (400F) for 20-25 mins 7. Heat up a pan and add oil 8. Add in the chicken and let cook for around 4-6 minutes 9. Move the chicken to one side, then add the butter followed by minced garlic 10. Once the chicken is fully cooked, add in the potatoes and mix in well 11. Garnish with freshly chopped parsley 12. Serve, top with more parsley 13. Enjoy! #garlicbutter #chickenandpotatoes #chicken #potatoes #dinnerideas
